newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 17.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Unions call for stronger strike movement, as civil servants demonstrate against unemployment and for higher pay.
-- Unions criticise government's choice of Lagardere to take over electronics group Thomson.

-- Daewoo Securities may take over indebted state-owned bank Societe Marseillaise de Credit as part of Daewoo conglomerate's plans to buy Thomson's Multimedia subsidiary, itself part of Lagardere's offer on Thomson.
-- EU authorities adopt projects on the status of future European single currency and on a monetary stability pact.
